capabilities: Browse a year of daily notes as swipeable month cards
Show a photo calendar with mood colors and a writing streak count
Write one-line entries with summary, mood, photos and notes
Search and filter entries by text, photos or mood
Resize entry photos and save them as JPEG
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; the cards are views of date-named daily notes.
extras: Only rewrites a note when saved from the quick entry screen, updating summary, mood and cover properties and leaving other properties alone. New photos are resized to 2048 px JPEG, which drops GPS data; formats the device cannot decode, such as some HEIC files, are saved unchanged. Interface available in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese; BRAT install supported.
problem: Daily notes are plain Markdown files, so reviewing a year of entries, seeing moods and photos, or adding a short entry takes many steps.

relations.evidence: Diary Cards is inspired by Oak Diary (Card Diary on iOS) by Oak Studio.
it uses the folder, date format and template from Obsidian's built-in Daily notes plugin

summary: Card-based browser and quick-entry editor for date-named daily notes, with month cards, a photo calendar, moods and streaks.
